excerpts:
Parallel announced a $2.4M seed round in October 2025 to build out its finance platform and fractional CFO network for early-stage startups. Renato Villanueva Cofounder Oct 9, 2025 Editor's note: This announcement reflects Parallel as of October 2025. Our product and positioning have since evolved — see [getparallel.com](../) for how Parallel works today.** **Parallel today announced a $2.4 million seed round and shared its goal of giving early-stage companies finance support that pairs software with a fractional CFO—without the cost and complexity of hiring in-house.\ ** **Renato Villanueva, Cofounder — Oct 9, 2025 **SALT LAKE CITY — October 9, 2025** — **Parallel** today announced a $2.4 million seed round and set out its goal of giving early-stage companies finance support that combines forecasting software with a fractional CFO—without the cost and complexity of hiring in-house. The $2.4 million seed round was led by Night Capital and K5 Tokyo Black, with participation from Penny Jar Capital, Background VC, Mintaka VC, Path Ventures and strategic operators including Jeron Paul (Founder, Spiff), Jared Rodman (Co-founder, Weave), Colin Zima (Founder, Omni) and Alex Bean (Co-founder, Divvy).
"Founders do not need another spreadsheet. They need an always current plan and a partner who can reason about tradeoffs," said Renato Villanueva, Parallel founder and CEO. "Parallel combines finance agents that do the work with CFO judgment that stands behind the plan, so teams can move faster with confidence—from hiring plans to the next raise."
**A live model:** Connect **QuickBooks** and **Puzzle** to stand up an auditable forecast in minutes and keep it current. **Embedded automation:** AI-assisted workflows to clean and map data, roll the model forward, run scenarios, explain variances in plain language, and help draft board and investor materials. **Expert oversight:** A dedicated **fractional CFO** to validate assumptions, add judgment, and take responsibility for the plan.
**Parallel today announced a $2.4 million seed round and shared its goal of giving early-stage companies finance support that pairs software with a fractional CFO—without the cost and complexity of hiring
**The Road Ahead** Our vision is simple: **finance should never be the reason a startup fails.** With Parallel, every founder can have the clarity, confidence, and tools to make smarter decisions and close rounds faster. This $2.4M seed is just the beginning, and we're excited to build alongside the next generation of ambitious founders. **About Parallel** Parallel helps VC‑backed founders get CFO‑level insight without building a finance team. By pairing forecasting software with fractional CFO support, Parallel was built to deliver faster planning, proactive scenarios, and board‑ready reporting, so founders always know their runway and can operate with confidence.
At launch, Parallel described a combined offering—**software plus service**—aimed at making elite finance more accessible: **A live model:** Connect **QuickBooks** and **Puzzle** to stand up an auditable forecast in minutes and keep it current. **Embedded automation:** AI-assisted workflows to clean and map data, roll the model forward, run scenarios, explain variances in plain language, and help draft board and investor materials. **Expert oversight:** A dedicated **fractional CFO** to validate assumptions, add judgment, and take responsibility for the plan. **Built to scale with you** The company's aim was for founder-led teams to use Parallel for runway modeling, headcount planning, and investor diligence, with onboarding that paired each team with a fractional CFO to oversee the initial plan and add judgment. As companies hire in-house finance leaders, the idea was for those teams to keep using the same platform. With role-based controls, audit trails, and live integrations, Parallel set out to serve as a startup's FP&A backbone from early stage through scale—without a tool switch.
At the time of this announcement, Parallel served **B2B SaaS** companies from pre-seed through Series A and beyond.
